crossRefs.note: In the morning, David wrote a letter to Joab, and sent it by the hand of Uriah.
If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t…
There is a vanity which is done on the earth, that there are righteous men to whom it happens according to the work of…

people.name: Jezebel
people.line: Queen of Israel; wife of King Ahab

people.name: Naboth
people.line: Jezreelite vineyard owner, unjustly killed by Ahab and Jezebel.

translations.web: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, “Naboth has been stoned, and is dead.”
translations.bsb: Then they sent word to Jezebel: “Naboth has been stoned to death.”
translations.kjv: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
translations.asv: Then they sent to Jezebel, saying, Naboth is stoned, and is dead.
